notes: Partition checked: 35 source morphemes in 33 units, 37 target tokens, each used once.

*that they might have no favor*: הֱיוֹת is written, so it takes the *have* itself, its לָ goes `unrepresented` and the suffix takes the subject pronoun *they* (rules 40, 43); the privative לְ keeps the complementizer and בִלְתִּי takes the *no* (rule 48).
מֵאֵת fuses to *of*, headed on the governing opening morpheme (rule 23); כַּאֲשֶׁר likewise to *as*.
The supplied *in* before battle goes to מִלְחָמָה, the nominal it stands before, whether read under rule 33 or as the recast relation of לִקְרַאת under rule 19 — both place it there.
All three ASV marginal notes were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
